note.note:
Please provide the following so I can generate the SOAP note:

- The full transcript (doctor and patient dialogue).
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON.

Notes on how I will proceed once you provide them:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source of factual information.
- I will use the DDx to enrich clinical reasoning only if consistent with the transcript; if there is conflict, I will include both statements and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will extract only clinically relevant information: presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, medications, allergies, social history (if provided), physical findings, working diagnosis/clinical impression, differential diagnoses (from DDx only if consistent), management, treatment, and follow-up plans.
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and add “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- I will present in American English, with concise, professional bullets under the exact headings you requested:
  - Subjective
  - Objective
  - Assessment & Plan (with Issue 1, Issue 2, etc.)
  - Quality checks (document_quality) including any missing elements, conflicts, and notes on transcript quality.

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON here.
